claims.explanation: UNC0321 is a picomolar EHMT2/G9a inhibitor whose cellular selectivity likely reflects dependence on G9a/GLP-mediated H3K9me2 and p53-K373 methylation for tumor cell survival, with TP53-mutant or p53-pathway-inactivated lines being more sensitive because they cannot rely on p53 tumor-suppressor responses. The pattern of selective killing in BRAF-mutant, TP53-mutant, and chromatin-remodeler-mutant lines (ARID1A, SMARCA4, KMT2C/D) suggests that epigenetic rewiring and loss of p53 function create vulnerability to EHMT2 inhibition, while lines with intact p53 and/or RTK-RAS-MAPK dependence (e.g., KRAS-mutant pancreas, some BRAF-mutant melanomas) are relatively protected.

features.basis: G9a methylates p53 K373 to inactivate it; TP53-mutant lines cannot use p53-dependent survival and are more dependent on G9a-mediated epigenetic repression
G9a/EHMT2 is the direct target and is overexpressed in many cancers; higher target expression predicts greater dependence and inhibitor effect
BRAF-mutant lines (thyroid, melanoma, glioma, ovary, endometrium) are enriched among selectively killed lines, suggesting MAPK-driven epigenetic dependence
ARID1A loss alters chromatin remodeling and is enriched in sensitive endometrial, lung, and liver lines, creating dependence on G9a-mediated H3K9me2
SWI/SNF loss (COV434, PLCPRF5, NCIH1793) may increase reliance on EHMT2-mediated repression for survival
KMT2C/MLL3 loss in sensitive lines suggests compensatory dependence on other histone methyltransferases such as G9a
KMT2D loss in HEC265 and other sensitive lines may create epigenetic vulnerability to EHMT2 inhibition
PTEN loss activates PI3K/AKT and is common in sensitive lines (endometrium, thyroid, lung, breast, liver), possibly linking to G9a-dependent survival
RB1 loss in several sensitive lines (ESS1, DMS273, FTC133) may impair cell-cycle control and increase dependence on G9a-mediated repression
KRAS-mutant pancreas and some lung lines are among the least affected, suggesting RAS/MAPK-driven lines may be less dependent on EHMT2
CDKN2A loss appears in several least-affected lines (SNU899, SCABER, HARA, 8305C, ASPC1), suggesting intact CDKN2A may not be required for sensitivity and its loss may mark resistant contexts
ATM mutation is enriched in least-affected lines (LCLC103H, SNU685, 786O, 8305C), possibly reflecting reduced DNA-damage-dependent sensitivity to epigenetic inhibition
